body.title: Add the team-only extras runner
body.summary: Add runUnitExtras and ExtrasOutcome: each approve-time extra (milestone, Epic task-list splice, design comment, review comment) runs as its own step that reports success or failure, its completion is recorded per extra in UnitIssue.extrasDone through patchTrackerMeta, a marked step is skipped, a failed step stays unmarked and is reported, and the stated residual repeat is a marker-write failure after a successful post.
acceptanceChecks: A step with a mark is skipped; a failed step is reported and unmarked; a second run after a partial success posts only the missing extras.
When the marker write fails after a successful post the next run posts that step again, as the LLD states.

tests.name: src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/unit-extras.test.ts: runUnitExtras marks, skips, reports failures, retries only missing steps and repeats only after a marker failure
